title: On the Error Analysis of Triangular Transport Maps for Conditional Generation via MMD-based Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2610.33610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional generative models parameterized by triangular transport maps are widely used for conditional sampling, yet theoretical guarantees on the quality of the conditional measures they produce remain scarce. We address this question for minimum divergence estimators of triangular maps. We use MMD-based objectives as a tractable setting in which the gap between joint and conditional errors can be analyzed precisely, and we measure performance through the average conditional estimation error, defined as the squared maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between the estimated and the true conditionals, averaged over the conditioning variable. We first show that the common practice of minimizing a joint MMD may fail to recover the conditionals: writing the joint and the conditional criteria as quadratic energies of the same conditional mean embedding residual, we prove that, for parametric classes, joint minimizers are generically inconsistent

translated_title: 基于MMD目标的条件生成中三角传输映射的误差分析
translated_abstract: 由三角传输映射参数化的条件生成模型被广泛用于条件采样，但对其所产生的条件测度质量的理论保证仍然十分匮乏。我们针对三角映射的最小散度估计器来研究这一问题。我们采用基于MMD的目标函数作为一个易于处理的框架，从而能够精确分析联合误差与条件误差之间的差距，并通过平均条件估计误差来度量性能，该误差定义为估计条件分布与真实条件分布之间的最大均值差异（MMD）的平方，并在条件变量上取平均。我们首先证明，最小化联合MMD这一常见做法可能无法恢复条件分布：通过将联合准则与条件准则表示为同一条件均值嵌入残差的二次能量形式，我们证明，对于参数类而言，联合最小化解通常是不一致的。
tldr: 本文对基于MMD目标的三角传输映射条件生成进行了误差分析，证明最小化联合MMD通常无法一致地恢复条件分布，并精确刻画了联合误差与条件误差之间的差距。
